title: Execute 128-lane input-block codebook W4 candidate

fresh_attempt_namespace.execution_marker_creation_rule: Create atomically exactly once only after exact V4 reproduction, deterministic candidate A/B identity, 169/169 V4-relative unweighted-SSE non-regression with strict aggregate improvement, 8/8 construction-blind non-evaluator exactness, 312 legal Dynamic Scale32 events, and complete hash verification produce PREATTEMPT_READY.json.

implementation_objective: Implement an isolated V7 runner and scalable backend that replace one tensor-wide codebook with one signed-Q4.4 codebook per contiguous 128 input channels while preserving one 4-bit index per weight, the existing per-output-row Scale32 records, grouped Dynamic Scale32 A8, the public ace2_shell contract, and the frozen source/quality identities.

required_constructor.initialization: Freshly recompute V4 from pinned BF16 weights and duplicate its tensor codebook into every 128-lane block so the initial V7 decoded weights are exactly V4.
required_constructor.objective: exact unweighted BF16 source-space SSE for all 169 Linear tensors
required_constructor.assignment: nearest row_scale times block_codepoint divided by 16; lower payload index wins exact ties
required_constructor.row_scale_update: exact complete-row dyadic least-squares ideal across every input block, constrained to no-overflow and legal Scale32; evaluate bracketing records, immediate normalized-significand neighbors, and the prior record with frozen tie rules
required_constructor.block_codebook_update: for each 128-lane input block, exact per-cluster quadratic costs over all signed-Q4.4 values plus dynamic programming for the globally minimum strictly increasing 16-entry codebook; empty clusters retain prior values and lexicographically smaller codebooks win cost ties
required_constructor.monotonicity: tensor SSE may not increase after any outer iteration
required_constructor.determinism: independent candidate A/B payload, row-scale, input-block-codebook, reconstruction, objective, iteration-trace, weight, and state manifests must match byte-for-byte

model_and_alias_policy.source_alias_assertion: lm_head.weight and model.embed_tokens.weight are the same Parameter and storage immediately after pinned-model load
model_and_alias_policy.split_operation: clone the complete embedding tensor into a detached non-trainable lm_head Parameter before construction and set only in-memory tie_word_embeddings false
model_and_alias_policy.embedding_preservation: original embedding object, storage, shape, dtype, and complete BF16 bytes remain unchanged
model_and_alias_policy.quantization_scope: exactly 168 transformer Linears plus separated lm_head

storage_and_accelerator_contract.weight_payload: one unsigned 4-bit input-block-codebook index per weight
storage_and_accelerator_contract.row_scale: one existing 32-bit Scale32 record per output row; zero additional row-scale bytes
storage_and_accelerator_contract.codebook: one aligned 16-byte signed-Q4.4 record per contiguous 128 input channels
storage_and_accelerator_contract.codebook_fetch_rule: authenticate and load one 128-bit codebook beat before each 128-input-lane weight block; consume blocks in increasing input-channel order

required_before_marker: hash-bound V7 runner, scalable backend, and exact input-block constructor self-test result
fresh V4 reconstruction and exact pre-optimization V4 reproduction witness
candidate A and B payload, row-scale, input-block-codebook, reconstruction, objective, iteration-trace, weight, and state manifests

constructor tests for block counts, ordering, V4 replication, Scale32 bracketing/neighbors/ties/range/all-zero rows, strict codebook dynamic-programming optimum, empty clusters, ties, packing, cache sequencing, and hash rejection
model-only report with 169/169 V4-relative SSE non-regression and strict aggregate improvement
the same eight non-evaluator inputs at 8/8 exact BF16 token arrays and 8/8 matching response-gate outcomes

fresh-candidate Dynamic Scale32 report with all 312 layer/event names, legal deltas, zero saturation, zero clipping, no reserved -128 payload, and 832 or fewer activation-metadata bytes per decoder-layer token
predeclared contract binding every source, model, matrix, runner, tool version, format, byte count, and policy hash
PREATTEMPT_READY.json that verifies all prior artifacts without creating execution_started.json
pre_attempt_artifact_set.preflight_failure_disposition: Preserve a hash-bound PREATTEMPT_NO_GO, leave attempt-0001 absent and unconsumed, keep selected_policy_id null, and submit the no-go to a Fresh Reviewer without accessing official inputs.

official_attempt_contract.generation: deterministic greedy argmax; no sampling; use_cache=false; maximum six generated tokens; termination IDs 151643 and 151645
official_attempt_contract.score_policy: binary only: 9/9 complete token arrays exactly equal BF16 and 9/9 response-gate outcomes equal BF16
official_attempt_contract.evaluator_no_execution_rule: If execution_started.json exists but no candidate prompt completes, preserve the attempt, keep numerical correctness null, and forbid replay.
official_attempt_contract.numerical_failure_rule: If any candidate prompt completes but the binary gate is not met, set eligible=false, preserve exact disagreements, keep selected_policy_id null, and forbid replay.
official_attempt_contract.numerical_success_rule: If the 9/9 binary gate is met, seal immutable evidence and submit it to a Fresh Reviewer; do not select the policy or authorize downstream work before independent acceptance.

acceptance_check: A Fresh Reviewer returns done after reproducing either a sealed marker-free PREATTEMPT_NO_GO with zero attempts consumed or a sealed single-attempt result, and verifies the 4.027884615-bit standard-layer storage calculation, exact V4 initialization, deterministic 128-lane block construction, 169/169 model gate, 8/8 preflight gate, 312-event Dynamic Scale32 legality, and all bound hashes.
prohibited_work: modify, resume, replay, reinterpret, or officially execute V6 or any consumed predecessor
create the V7 execution marker during planning, runner development, construction, or preflight
use official nine-prompt inputs, outputs, token arrays, response gates, hidden harness sources, or golden outputs for construction or preflight
add per-group or per-scalar weight scales, sparse exceptions, wider per-weight payloads, extra row-scale records, prompt-dependent codebook selection, or codebooks smaller than 128 input lanes
exceed 4.036 stored bits per weight or omit codebook traffic from the byte accounting
modify RTL, testbenches, formal properties, synthesis constraints, certified PPA evidence, or the sealed two-token record
retarget or claim the arbitrary-text demo
begin U280 integration, emulation, bitstream, or board work
